question: What distinction must be understood regarding clan and non-clan in relation to the goddess?
premises: Both non-clan and clan must be known
The clan of the goddess is referenced
This understanding is addressed to the fair one
inference: One must discern non-clan and clan, including the clan of the goddess.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of the second occurrence of kulaṃ is ambiguous
plain_english: O fair one, having known both non-clan and clan, and the clan of the goddess.
